title: Blueberry Jam Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
description:
Blueberry Jam Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
A Flavor Explosion in Every Puff
Discover the bold and irresistibly sweet taste of the Blueberry Jam Geek Bar Pulse X 25000. Bursting with juicy blueberry notes and a hint of sugary jam, this vape delivers a vibrant flavor experience that will keep you coming back for more.
Effortless Convenience
Designed as a high-quality disposable, the Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 lets you enjoy its exceptional flavor and smooth vapor without the hassle of maintenance or refills. Just unbox it, puff, and savor the simplicity.
Ultimate Smooth Vaping Experience
Every puff from the Blueberry Jam Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 is perfectly crafted for a silky, consistent vape that satisfies. Its sleek and lightweight design makes it perfect for on-the-go use, fitting easily into your pocket or bag.
Key Features
Puff Count:
Up to 25,000 (Regular Mode) or 15,000 (Pulse Mode)
E-liquid:
18mL, 5% nicotine
Battery:
820mAh rechargeable (USB-C)
Display:
Smart 3D Curved LED Screen
Coils:
Dual Mesh for superior flavor
Modes:
Soft, Normal, Pulse
Airflow: Adjustable for customized draw
Bring a burst of flavor and convenience to your vaping routine with the Blueberry Jam Geek Bar Pulse X 25000. Taste the perfect balance of indulgence and practicality, one puff at a time.
